english: Okay, let's get going, everyone!
Will it really be all right?
Maid practice was fun, desu~!
Fun!? You've gotta be kidding!\nNever again, no way!
Maid training's great.\nEveryone was so cute!
Please forget it...
Will a crash course in maid training\nreally be enough?
That's fine!\nThe company president just likes maid outfits,\nso they're not expecting real quality.
What a strange company.\nCycling maids through shifts\njust for the president's hobby.
A shady company! I don't like it!
Rich people's hobbies are often like that.
What a creep!
Riko thinks so too!\nSo we can steal without a shred of guilt!
So your treasure's being kept\nin that tacky company's building?
Exactly.\nI checked every place Mii was involved with\naround here and tracked it down.
What should we do?\nCleaning?
The contract with Riko is:\nuntil Riko gets the rosary,\nwatch and guard inside the building, and help her escape.
If nothing happens,\njust do the job like normal, okay?\nRiko'll handle opening the president's safe.
And if you screw up?
Then I'm counting on you!
If this works, you'll testify in the Supreme Court?
Of course.
(Really, kana? Kana?)
(We should stay on guard.)
It's fine! It'll be over quick!\nOkay, operation staaart!
//fade to black\n//Event CG: Charles in a maid outfit
How is it? This maid outfit's\npretty risqué... doesn't it look weird?
No problem.
But if I clean in this outfit,\nwon't it show...?
The president presumably has those tastes.
I wouldn't mind if it were someone I like, but\nfor work this is a problem...
Even so, we can't just not work.
Yeah, but... ugh,\ndressed like this I'll end up\nthinking weird thoughts.
Clothes really matter... it's like my heart\nbecomes a girl's too,\nyeah... it's embarrassing, but...
(In front of someone I like, maybe it'd be fine...\nWait, what am I thinking!?)
//Event CG off.\n//fade to black
Good, good, everyone's working hard.\nWhile they're at it... fufu,\na safe like this is easy...
//SE: safe unlocking
It's open!
Finally... finally found it!\nMother's keepsake, the "Rosary"...!
With this, all the cards are in hand!\nNow...
//An alarm sounds.
Tch, the trap wasn't on the safe door but inside!
Oh well, I've got insurance for that.\nI just escape through the window! Kufu!
//SE: window glass shattering.
Ormes and my silly friends,\nthe rest is up to you!
Ahahahaha!!\nMother's rosary!\nIt's finally back!
Today, I'll finally become myself...!!
Watch me, Mother...
//Event CG off.\n//Background: city\n//Everyone has fled the company building. Back in their normal clothes.
Is everyone okay!?
What the hell! She screwed up after all!
She really can't do a single thing right!
Her thoroughness\nis almost refreshing!
What's going to happen now?
Word will reach Mii soon.\nSo naturally, next...
Enemy attack!
Riko!
//Battle map: city\n//Riko, Aria, Houki, Satoko & Rika force-deployed. Riko counts as a third force.
What do you mean, enemy attack!?\nIsn't this because you screwed up!?
What are you getting wrong~?\nThe enemy's already here.
What do you mean...?
Once I take back the rosary,\nall that's left is beating Ormes... kufufu!
You... planned this\nfrom the start!
I told you before, right?\nI'd beat Ormes-with-a-partner\nand prove I'm the better one.
And for that I needed the rosary\nmy mother gave me.
The rosary?\nWhat's so special about that rosary!?
Aria...\nhave you ever lived in a tiny cage,\ngiven only rotten meat and muddy water?
Huh...
I was kept alive as nothing but a machine\nto pass my great-grandfather's superior genes\nto the next generation...
(Satoko, calm yourself...)
Like hell!\nI'm Riko Mine Lupin the Fourth!\nNot a machine for birthing the Fifth!!
The rosary is the Lupin clan's secret treasure,\ngiven to me by my beloved mother...!
Even locked in that cage,\nI hid it in my mouth\nso they'd never take it...
And I realized.\nThis rosary,\nthis metal... gives Riko power!
Let's settle this, Ormes!\nToday I'll beat you and prove\nI've surpassed my great-grandfather!
And I'll be free!!
//Riko approaches Aria.
Wh!? Her hair moves like hands...!
Tch! So that's your\ntrue power...
Next one finishes it...!!
Ahahahaha! Riko-chin\nhasn't noticed a thiiing!
What!?
//Mii and grunt enemies appear.
Mii!
So you've shown yourself!
This rosary is Riko's!!\nI won't give it to you!!
Pfft! Ahahahahahahahahahaha\nhahahahahahahahahahaha\n*cough cough*!
What's so funny!!
Because~ Riko-chin has zero\ntalent as a phantom thief, but\nshe's a natural-born comedian~!
What do you mean!?
What Riko-chin stole is a fake.\nOne Mii whipped up —\na bright-red FA-KE!
Wh-what are you saying!?\nI mean, I could use my powers...
That's right~! You could~!\nBecause I made it work just the same~!
But, but, look closely?\nNot a scratch or speck of dirt, right?\nIt's freshly made, so it's all shiny~!
Ahahahaha!\nIt's your precious mama's keepsake,\nand you didn't even notice it's a fake~!
Are you stupid? Or were you so scared of Mii\nthat running away took everything you had~!?\nAhaha! The real one's over here~!
You...!
I watched you crack that safe, every second.\nA sorry little inferior creature\ntricking Mii? Impossible~!
Blad-chan said it too —\nRiko-chan makes the\nabsolute best toy!
Every job I gave you, all failures!\nPlus stealing a fake and looking smug!\nAhahahaha!
//Gunshot.
Don't laugh!!
Ow?
Now it's clear!\nYou're our enemy!
Huh~? Why is Aria-chan\nangry~?
Riko! You know what I'm thinking!\nLet's do what needs doing first!!
Ormes...!
We'll take the rosary back from her!!\nEverything else comes after!!
Got it...!
//Battle start.\n//Riko acts as an allied NPC targeting Mii.
Apologize first!!
Mii's the king, y'know? Kings don't apologize~!
You snot-nosed brat who can't tell\nright from wrong when you're playing around!\nWhat kind of king is that!!
Didn't you know?\nA king can do whatever she wants!
Shut up! Kazaana!!
//Talk event when Mii and Riko engage.
Give back the rosary!!
Nooo! If Mii'd kept quiet,\nyou'd never have noticed it was a fake~\nNo rosary for the dummy!
Unforgivable... absolutely unforgivable!!
The unforgivable one is\nthe failure of the phantom-thief clan, I think~?\nAhahahahaha!!
//Talk event when Mii engages Rika & Satoko.
I have just one thing\nI wish to say to you.
What is it?
You confuse "interesting"\nwith "fun"!
Why? If Mii thinks it's interesting, it's interesting,\nand if Mii thinks it's fun, it's fun!
Hah. Completely missing the point.
It's fine! As long as Mii's having fun!
//Clear when Mii's HP drops below a set amount.
No good. No challenge at all!\nIf you don't try harder,\nMii won't have any fun!
This composure...!
Give back my mother's rosary!!
Nooo!
//Mii vanishes. The grunts vanish too.
Dammit! Mocking me like that!
Riko, can't you chase her?
The box for traveling between worlds\nhas already been destroyed by Mii... obviously.
Riko Mine...
But I won't give up... never!!
//Battle end.\n//Background: city (daytime)
See ya, Ormes.
Where are you going?
It's decided! I'm going after Mii!\nAnd this time I'll take the rosary back!
...Wait.\nOur contract isn't over yet.
What?
The contract lasts until you get\nthe rosary, right?\nDon't just wander off on your own.
Are you stupid?\nYou're my enemy! Ormes!
Butei Charter, Article 2:\nalways honor your contract with a client.
If you're not breaking the contract,\nthen our contract with you still stands.\nWhat'll it be?
Aria...
...Don't get the wrong idea!\nIt's not for you,\nit's for my mama!
//The following branches on Riko's flag.
I don't plan on getting cozy with you.\nI'll do it alone.
I'll get the rosary back, no matter what.\nAfter that, let's settle this, Ormes.
She won't listen... huh.
That idiot...!
//END
Besides, you want to\nsettle things with me, right?
Then traveling together is more efficient!\nWe'll be near each other, so right after\nwe get it back, we can settle it!
Using a duel as the reason...\nQuite the persuasive technique.
Really, you're worried about Riko-san, right?
Wh—! N-no, I'm not!\nI just want to quickly clear up\nthis bad blood and feel better!
That's a stretch, isn't it?
Always such a tacked-on excuse... right?
I said it's not!!
...Hmph.
Where are you going!?
Aria-san, let me talk with Riko-san.
You, Satoko?
It seems Satoko has\nsomething on her mind.
Hearing about her past,\nI can't treat it as someone else's problem.
Satoko, you... have memories of the past...?
Yes, I do. So let me!
...All right. Please.
Yes!
//fade to black\n//Background: back alley (somewhere different from the usual city)
Dammit... dammit!!\nWhy am I so...!!
May I have a moment?
Come to keep watch?\nA useless kid like you... don't mock me!
I would never mock you!\nBecause I might have been trying\nto become like you.
...What are you talking about?
When my parents died, I was abused\nunder a horrible uncle.
But unlike you, I wasn't strong,\nalways asking others for help,\nand I hated my own weakness...
So, did you come to be my apprentice or something?
No. Right now I'm working\non becoming stronger too,\non being okay without asking others for help.
You don't look like you're\nmuch use, though?
True.\nBut please hear me out, Riko-san.
Leaning on people and\nborrowing their strength are different things.
How are they different?
When you have a goal, work as hard as you can\nto achieve it, and still fall short,\nthere's no shame in asking for help.
No one is alone.\nIf you have comrades walking beside you,\njoining forces is only natural.
That's weakling logic!
Do you want to become strong?\nLike that Mii-san?
Mii...?
I don't think she's wonderful\nin the slightest.
Riko-san and I both want to grow stronger.\nBut aiming to become something self-centered\nlike Mii-san is wrong, I think.
Please think it over carefully.
Satoko Houjou...
Riko Mine-san,\nyou are not alone.
First, there is one here who will fight beside you.\nDon't forget that.\nNow, excuse me.
What's with her, the cheeky...!
Fufu. Satoko is the second.\nThe first was me.
Jeanne!
What I can tell you is,\nthis group is far more comfortable\nthan I expected.
That's not like you...
It's not that they're soft.\nYou can just be yourself — that's all.
Be myself?
No one's above or below anyone,\nnothing's forced on you,\nand nothing gets in your way.
Liar! You're saying I've been losing\nto a bunch of carefree people!?
You'll understand if you act with them.\nEveryone learns from failure, celebrates success, shares it.\nThat becomes strength.
I.U. is a free organization too,\nbut it's a completely different kind of freedom.\nI can't quite put it into words...
Ah, no need to draw it.
I see... Satoko said a grade-schooler\nwould do better, too.
Pfft! She's awful, that girl!\nJeanne, you poor thing... ahaha!
Fufu... here,\nall you need is that face.\nEasy, right?
...I see.
//fade to black\n//Background: outside Butei High
Ah, you're back!\nSo, Riko, what'll it be?
Non-non! That's not it!
Now, repeat after me!\n"Welcome home, milady!"
Huh!?
I told you when we made the contract!\nMake a contract with Riko and become maids.\nIf the contract's still on, you're still maids, right?
Like hell!!
Riko-san, you've sorted out your feelings?
Hmm... hey, Satoko-chan,\nwhat do you think of Jeanne's drawing?
Jeanne-san's drawing?\nWhat about a kindergartner's scribble?
Pfft! It'd be fun to secretly hang it\non a kindergarten wall!
Nice idea!\nIt'd do Jeanne-san good\nto face reality.
That can't be!\nMy drawing should be easy to understand!
Nope.
Nope.
Nope.
...Are your eyes bad?
That's YOU!!
Sheesh, getting all serious\nfeels silly now.\nAnyway, I'm with you till we beat Mii!
You should've said that from the start!
Aria was throwing a fit\nabout doing it alone at first too!\nRiko saw it~.
Shut up shut up shuuut up!
//END
